1. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: first, second and third members formed from laminated composite tape, the first and second members defining a web and __at least one flange__ member being joined to the flanges and extending generally transverse to the web, the first, second and third composite members intersecting to form a void; a filler disposed in and substantially filling the void; __at least one layer of composite fabric on each of the members in the area of the filler, wherein the composite fabric is applied as a separate layer distinct from the laminated composite tape of the members__; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric.

2. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the first and second members include radius areas between the web and each of the flanges, and the fabric layer covers the radius areas, __and wherein the adhesive layer is applied as a separate structural adhesive layer distinct from any resin contained within the laminated composite tape or composite fabric__.

4. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric includes graphite fibers held in an epoxy matrix, __and wherein the composite fabric layer is a separate reinforcing layer applied to the surface of the members__.

5. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the layer of adhesive and the at least one layer of composite fabric extend beyond the radius areas, __and wherein the adhesive layer is a structural adhesive applied as a separate layer distinct from the resin matrix of the composite fabric and laminated composite tape__.

6. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric of the composite members are offset relative to each other, __and wherein the offset composite fabric layers are applied as separate reinforcing layers on the surfaces of the members__.

7. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: a pair of composite channels joined together, each of the channels including a web, flanges extending from the web, and radius areas between the web and each of the flanges; a base extending transverse to the web and joined to each of the flanges, the radius areas of the channels and the base forming at least one radius filler zone; a reinforcing member filling the radius filler zone; __a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas of the channels and the base, wherein the composite fabric is applied as a separate reinforcing layer distinct from the laminated composite tape of the channels and base__; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric layer, __wherein the adhesive layer is a structural adhesive applied as a separate layer distinct from any resin contained within the laminated composite tape or composite fabric__.

12. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the composite fabric layer includes three composite patches respectively on each of the channels and the base, __and wherein each patch is applied as a separate reinforcing layer__.

13. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the layer of adhesive includes a sheet of structural adhesive wrapped around the filler, __and wherein the structural adhesive sheet is applied as a separate adhesive layer distinct from any resin matrix of the composite fabric or laminated composite tape__.

14. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the layer of adhesive extends beyond the radius filler zone into interfacial layers between the channels and between the base and each of the flanges, __and wherein the adhesive is a structural adhesive applied as a separate layer__.

15. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the channels are __formed from laminated composite tape and the base is formed from laminated composite tape, and wherein the composite fabric layer and structural adhesive layer are applied as separate reinforcing and bonding layers__.

25. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener for aircraft applications, comprising: an I-section structure formed of laminated composite tape having a web and flanges on each end of the web, the structure including a pair of composite channels each having radius areas between the web and the flanges and a cap and a base, the cap being joined to the first set of the flanges and the base being joined to the second set of flanges, the cap and the base each intersecting the web in the radius areas to define a radius filler zone; __a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas of the I-section structure defining the radius filler zone, wherein the composite fabric is applied as a separate reinforcing layer distinct from the laminated composite tape__; a reinforcing filler in the radius filler zone; and __a layer of structural adhesive surrounding and joining the filler to the composite fabric in the radius filler zone, wherein the structural adhesive is applied as a separate adhesive layer distinct from any resin matrix of the composite fabric or laminated composite tape__.
